violation_type.title: Primary Caregiver's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge (26 TAC §747.203(1))
violation_type.short_title: Primary Caregiver's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge
violation_type.typical_finding: During Inspection director was not present. A caregiver was asked who was in charge and she said that no one was assigned to be in charge.
